text:
Aisha: quick thought — want to add a small 'Route & quota impact' panel to the Role Preview in Console. It would show which routing policies the role can hit and an estimated cost/latency delta. cc @Marco @Ben

Marco: interesting. Two quick flags: 1) exposing cost numbers could surface billing info across teams, 2) important to show fallback behavior (e.g., dedicated -> hosted).

Ben: +1 on the fallback visibility. For cost, suggest showing relative impact (low/medium/high or +5%/+30%), not raw $ unless tenant has permission. We can compute estimates from sampled telemetry.

Lisa: also think about scoped routes — some routes are premium (requires dedicated capacity) and some are regional. UI needs to indicate gating and whether the role can change routing policy.

Aisha: draft mock idea: panel lists routes the role can access, a small badge (latency | cost | fallback) and a tooltip. Example UI copy: ```
Routes affected (3)
• /v1/generate — latency-sensitive · cost: high · fallback: hosted
• /v1/embeddings — batch-friendly · cost: low
• /v1/rerank — restricted · requires-dedicated
Estimated cost impact: ~+10% (based on 7d sample)
```

Marco: backend question — we'll need an API to simulate per-role route access + metric projection. Suggest endpoint: `POST /internal/perm-simulate` with body {role_id, sample_window_days, qps_assumption}. Can spike. @deploy-bot create ticket?

deploy-bot: created ticket #4567 — perm-simulate-api (assignee: Marco)

Ben: privacy/enterprise concern: add per-tenant toggle to disable estimates and redact percents for orgs that opt out. Also decide sampling floor so estimates aren't noisy for low-traffic routes.

Lisa: UX note — if role can change routing policy we should surface an inline CTA to open policy editor, but behind a permission. Avoid confusing viewers who only have read access.

Aisha: action items: Marco spike API + perf cost, Ben to propose telemetry sampling/aggregation, Lisa to mock small panel + copy, I'll draft feature flag + rollout plan.

Marco: on it — will post spike gist when ready.

Ben: I'll reach out to privacy for redaction guidance.

Lisa: I'll upload mock to FigJam later today.

Aisha: thanks everyone :thumbsup:
